note: New process-wide knob for the application/json default given to a non-empty request body without Content-Type: vespera_inprocess::set_default_json_content_type / VESPERA_DEFAULT_JSON_CONTENT_TYPE, JNI VesperaBridge.configureDefaultJsonContentType(boolean) / -Dvespera.request.defaultJsonContentType, Spring vespera.bridge.native.default-json-content-type, C vespera_configure_default_json_content_type(int). Default stays true (no behaviour change); false is recommended for browser-facing apps, so axum Json<T> rejects an untyped cross-site body with 415.
